messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the PM-2024-058 postmortem (API tail-latency). We sketched several mitigations during the bridge but haven't assigned clear owners, Jira links, or a RACI. Main asks: 1) owner for infra/config change, 2) owner for perf/regression tests, 3) timeline to close.
ritika: I can own the perf/regression side (INF-4013). Plan: add nightly p95/p99 job, a replay-driven regression harness, and two small synthetic load tests to replicate the tail. ETA: Wed next week for test scaffolding.
ben: I'll take the infra/config change (INF-4012). Quick plan: add connection-pool guard, tune eviction policy, and a traffic-class canary rollout. ETA: PR by EOD Friday + rollout plan. @ritika can you own verification? :thumbsup: 
sre-bot: Postmortem recorded: PM-2024-058. Reminder: link remediation tickets to the postmortem and set owners.
sam: Please include acceptance criteria in the tickets: 1) p99 < 200ms on scaled load; 2) error rate delta < 0.5%; 3) rollback steps documented.
eng-lead: RACI draft: ben = R (implement), ritika = A (verify/tests), sam = C (postmortem owner/QA), pm-ux = I (customer impact), sre-bot = I (alerts & automation). If vendor image changes needed, loop in infra-ops.
pm-ux: I'll add the CX impact note and monitor dashboards post-change. Also request a status update in the weekly ops sync if not closed.
ben: INF-4012 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4012 - assigned to ben. Adding rollback steps and a canary checklist now.
ritika: INF-4013 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4013 - assigned to ritika. I'll attach historical traces and the replay harness.
ben: Adding quick config snippet to INF-4012: ```
max_connections: 500
connection_guard: true
eviction_policy: lru_tiered
```
ben: Also adding acceptance criteria to the ticket: p99 threshold, no >0.5% error delta, canary run for 2 hours at 10% traffic.
sre-bot: INF-4012 transitioned to In Progress by ben.
sam: Noting a recurring pattern - similar tail spikes on 2024-03-12, 2024-04-07, and 2024-05-21. @ritika please attach the three traces to INF-4013 so tests can reproduce.
ritika: Kicked off first replay run against headless harness; p95 looks better but p99 still elevated. Will iterate and post results in INF-4013 tonight.
ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/678 - feature-flagged config + canary script. Will run canary tomorrow morning and post outcome.
pm-ux: Target to resolve and verify within 2 sprints (3 weeks). If blocked, escalate in weekly ops review.
eng-lead: Thanks all. Please keep the postmortem linked and use ticket comments for updates rather than burying info in PRs. We'll review RACI + closure at the next postmortem follow-up meeting.
sam: Thanks — looping back once canary + replay tests finish, will close remediation if green.
